game.name: Superman Returns (Italy)
game.desc: Superman Returns for Xbox 360 is an action game adapted from the feature film of the same name in which you play as the famous flying man with his underwear over his trousers. Explore the 200 km² of Metropolis by flying or running like lightning and confront enemies well known to fans of the comics such as Bizarro and Metallo. Many enemies and missions await you, not to mention your superpowers such as heat vision and ice blast.
